messages:
elaine: Starting a large docs refactor today — splitting into multiple small PRs to keep previews manageable. I’ll open them in batches and coordinate merges.

sam: please drop PR links when open, I can take the file moves review.

elaine: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1820 (moves), /1821 (redirects), /1822 (sdk-snippets), /1823 (examples), /1824 (anchor-fixes). Preview hub: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/ (use PR anchor links)

maria: I’ll own redirects (/1821) + search reindex checklist. Ping me once the preview is stable.

docsbot: preview ready for /1820 — https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-1820 — build: green, accessibility: 2 warnings

sam: accessibility warnings noted, will fix after move pass. Also: moves will change anchors; add redirects and validator.

elaine: Merge order proposal (do not merge out of sequence):
1) /1820 (moves) — wait for preview green
2) /1821 (redirects) — mapping must cover all renamed paths
3) /1822 (sdk-snippets) — update snippet runner outputs
4) /1823 (examples) — smaller content tweaks
5) /1824 (anchor-fixes) — final pass + search reindex

jordan: What merge window are we targeting? avoid Friday deploys.

tim: Targeting Wed 10:00 PT merge window. I’ll set branch protection requiring "docs-preview:green" and block merges outside window.

sam: Quick pre-merge checklist (run locally):
`````
# check for broken anchors
python tools/linkchecker.py docs/ --anchors
# re-run search index build locally to spot title mismatches
scripts/build_search_index.sh
`````

maria: Redirect format we should use: single-line JSON array per mapping for validator:
`````
["/old/path","/new/path",301]
`````
I’ll add /scripts/validate_redirects.py to check coverage.

ci-bot: CI statuses: /1820: success, /1821: building preview, /1822: lint failed (snippet mismatch)

elaine: I’ll patch snippet mismatch in /1822 this afternoon. Tagging @sam @maria for reviews. :eyes:

sam: will review /1820 and /1821 once previews are green.

ej (added by sam): question — will infra run the search reindex post-merge or do we need a separate infra PR?

maria: infra will run reindex as a post-merge job; platform team coordinating. We should not run a live reindex during the merge window.

docsbot: preview warning: search index stale — moved pages still show old titles on preview. Expect corrections after post-merge reindex.

elaine: If blockers appear, add label "hold/merge-block" and ping #release-war-room. We’ll do a canary by merging a handful of pages first to validate redirects.

sam: starting reviews now, will post comments inline.

maria: drafting full redirect map and posting it here when ready.

ci-bot: latest builds: /1820: success, /1821: success, /1822: success, /1823: success, /1824: pending

elaine: Thanks everyone — Wed 10:00 PT merge window. Keep previews and comments tight. :party-parrot:
